##### Project general facts

LIV Maritime is a landmark 47-storey waterfront residential development distinguished by its striking glass architecture and collection of luxury residences, including apartments, townhouses, and duplex homes. Designed to embrace a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living, the project combines contemporary design with spacious layouts and expansive living areas. The architecture maximizes natural light and openness, while the residences are thoughtfully crafted to create an elegant and sophisticated living experience inspired by the surrounding waterfront setting.

Residents enjoy a curated selection of premium lifestyle amenities designed to support relaxation, wellness, and everyday comfort. The development features a grand double-height lobby with 24-hour concierge service, creating a hotel-inspired arrival experience. Additional leisure and recreational facilities provide residents with spaces for fitness, relaxation, social interaction, and community living, enhancing the overall residential experience.

The residences feature high-quality finishes and carefully selected premium materials throughout. Living spaces include elegant flooring, bespoke joinery, marble detailing, refined metal accents, and custom-fitted sliding doors that create a seamless transition between indoor and outdoor areas. Kitchens are equipped with state-of-the-art built-in appliances and contemporary finishes, while bathrooms feature premium European brands including Villeroy & Boch, complemented by custom cabinetry and modern walk-in showers. Bedrooms are thoughtfully designed with built-in wardrobes, integrated storage solutions, and refined interior detailing that combines practicality with a sophisticated aesthetic.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Maritime City is a dynamic and specialized community at the core of Dubai, dedicated to serving the maritime industry. As a comprehensive maritime hub, it offers a full spectrum of infrastructure, services, and facilities that support shipbuilding, maintenance, and a wide range of marine-related activities.

The area is purposefully designed to accommodate maritime businesses and professionals, featuring advanced shipyards, dry docks, and zones for maritime services and marine equipment suppliers. It also hosts educational and training institutions focused on the maritime field, creating a well-rounded ecosystem for industry growth and innovation.

Strategically located near Dubai’s key ports and transport networks, Dubai Maritime City provides excellent connectivity to international trade routes. This advantageous positioning ensures efficient logistics, easy access for businesses and residents, and strengthens its role as a vital link in the global maritime chain.
